Trainer: Afternoon all, radio checks at handover.
Coordinator: The Companion Animal Travel Desk is steady, and safety stays ahead of speed on every case.
Planner: <<FACT F093>> 
Handler: I have the pet files aligned, and any hold notes are clear before handoff.
Coordinator: Good work, and please keep the carriers checked for comfort, ventilation, and clean ID tags.
Dispatcher: If a transfer needs escalation, use the usual path and keep the record brief.
Handler: <<FACT F106>> 
Planner: I will keep the passenger notes tidy, and I will flag any special handling early.
Coordinator: Thank you all, and keep calm with each traveler so the process feels smooth.
Trainer: If Sana Nguyen or Sofia Larsen comes through with Koda, stay reassuring and follow the standard steps.
Dispatcher: The team should confirm each crate latch, water plan, and fit for the cabin or hold.
Coordinator: We are covered well, and a careful handover helps every animal travel with less stress.
